# OpenShift CLI administrator command reference {#cli-administrator-commands}

To learn more about the {{ oc_first }} administrator commands, review their descriptions and example commands. You must have `cluster-admin` or equivalent permissions to use these commands.

For developer commands, see the "OpenShift CLI developer command reference".

Run `oc adm -h` to list all administrator commands or run `oc <command> --help` to get additional details for a specific command.
